# agyn_env (Resource)

Manages an Agyn environment variable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_organization" "example" {
  name = "example-org"
}

resource "agyn_agent" "example" {
  organization_id = agyn_organization.example.id
  name            = "example-agent"
  role            = "assistant"
  model           = "gpt-4o"
  image           = "ghcr.io/agynio/agent-runtime:v1.0.0"
  description     = "Example agent managed by Terraform."
}

resource "agyn_env" "example" {
  name        = "LOG_LEVEL"
  description = "Example environment variable."
  agent_id    = agyn_agent.example.id
  value       = "info"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Environment variable name.

### Optional

- `agent_id` (String) Target agent identifier.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `mcp_id` (String) Target MCP identifier.
- `secret_id` (String) Secret reference identifier.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Plain-text value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the environment variable.
